summary: Regression + feature testing after moving app.include_router(api_router) to the bottom of server.py. Verified all pre-existing routes still respond (root, master avatar, tips feed, login) and the new learning + code-reading endpoints work with proper auth guards. Verdict logic (veto <0.4 n>=6, boost >=0.7 n>=6, else ok) validated across master/hq/code arrays. _code_read_interpret rules confirmed via direct import (team_total_under_low, team_total_over_cap, straight_win_nobet). Frontend Statistics tab renders Code Reading toggle which expands the panel with examples, upload button, empty-reads message, and Learning-Stats panel with populated master (10 rows) and hq (9 rows) learn-rows. 11/11 pytest passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~10945 lines — significantly over the 700-line guideline; should be split into feature modules (auth, tips, master, learning, code-reading) for maintainability.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated (warnings in test run). Should migrate to lifespan handlers.
emergentintegrations uses deprecated Pydantic V1 @validator — external, but worth pinning/monitoring.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression test file /app/backend/tests/test_learning_regression.py covers include_router move + learning/code-reading endpoints and can be reused. Frontend Code Reading toggle is inside Statistics tab (click 'Statistics' button in top nav, scroll to bottom, click 'Code Reading' toggle). data-testids: code-reading-toggle-btn, code-reading-view, code-example-N, code-reading-upload-btn, code-reading-empty, learning-stats-panel, learn-group-master, learn-group-hq, learn-row-<pattern>. Learning stats endpoint /api/learning/stats is public; refresh POST /api/admin/learning/refresh requires admin bearer token. Real OCR scan not tested (per instructions).
